promotionRule: No donor or evidence package enters app/src without a concrete active V1 consumer. VERIFIED means source-backed, not automatically runtime-safe. PARTIAL and CONFLICT claims cannot drive a production plan. Promote the smallest subset needed by the current user flow, with provenance and tests.
